title: 第2772章 借力破境第2771章 生死两分与生死之间
content_zh:
传说中专属于生死天尊的天神兵一出，整片虚无之地骤然沉寂。
尤其是在全面爆发、展现出生死之间大道层次的生死殿主的三大神王身影下，更是复苏到前所未有的地步上。
虚无之地中的所有生死规则，都在汹涌而来。
甚至乎，沿着生死天门，生死界的生死规则，都在急速涌现而至。
天尊生死轮进一步复苏，展现出更为惊人的太古至尊天威。
这一刻，饶是双方八大准神王都变色了。
生死城主本尊神王骨身摇颤不已，出现了更多的细微裂痕。
虽然血肉化作生死二分身，但神魂中传递出来凝重的神念，可见情况是多么危急。
轰！
生死古城的虚影骤然出现，悬于生死城主神王骨身的头顶上。
这座生死天尊的昔日天尊古城，同样爆发出炽盛的生死天威。
只不过，天尊古城终究是不如天尊生死轮这件真正的天神兵，何况只是一道虚影而已。
生死古城虚影摇摇欲坠，显得越发地虚淡，即将承受不住而炸开。
“没用的，萧玄，你无论是修为境界，还是神兵层次，都比不上老夫，如何抵挡得住？”
“送你往生！”
伴随着生死殿主一道冷漠无情的声音响起。
轰！
天尊生死轮如似一轮阴阳大日，骤然轰向生死城主。
生死古城虚影只是坚持了片刻不到，直接炸开，成为齑粉。
生命城主分身，以及死亡城主分身，已然冲天而起，配合上生死城主本尊，展现出全新的生死太极图，与之抵挡。

轰！
整片虚无之地在这一刻剧烈震颤，亿万里虚空寸寸崩碎。
生死太极图骤然崩溃。
生命城主分身连带着通天神树炸开。
死亡城主分身，也与死亡地狱的浩瀚世界，共同化作滚滚死亡雾霭……
生死城主本尊的神王骨身再也承受不住，生死天道之力的碾压之下四分五裂，化作漫天翻涌的骨雾以及魂雾。
生死二气疯狂交织，却始终无法凝聚成型。
生死神殿一方的三大底蕴级老古董望着那道在生死天道之力下炸裂的神王雾霭，眼中翻涌着复杂的情绪。
“少神子终究还是差了一步。”
“殿主动用了天尊生死轮，蕴含至尊天道之力的攻击，少神子如何能够抵挡。”
……
人族至尊古路一方。
四大准神王级古路护道者，个个面色难看至极。
却无能为力。
炎宵神主声音阴沉：“城主大人本就处于下风，如今生死殿主祭出天尊生死轮，这一击蕴含了生死天尊留下的至高天道之力，城主大人怕是凶多吉少了。”
content_en:
As soon as the legendary divine soldiers belonging to the God of Life and Death appeared, the entire land of nothingness suddenly fell silent.
Especially under the figure of the three great god kings who fully erupted and showed the masters of the life and death palaces at the level of the road between life and death, they have recovered to an unprecedented level.
All the rules of life and death in the land of nothingness are coming.
Even along the gate of life and death, the rules of life and death in the world of life and death are emerging rapidly.
The Heavenly Lord's Wheel of Life and Death further revived, showing even more astonishing immemorial Supreme Heavenly Power.
At this moment, even the eight quasi-god kings on both sides changed their colors.
The skeletal body of the God King, Lord of Life and Death City, was shaking, and more tiny cracks appeared.
Although the flesh and blood turned into two clones of life and death, the dignified spiritual thoughts conveyed from the soul showed how critical the situation was.
boom!
The phantom of the ancient city of life and death suddenly appeared, hanging above the head of the skeletal body of the Lord God King of the city of life and death.
This ancient city of the former Heavenly Lord of Life and Death also burst out with the blazing power of Life and Death.
However, Tianzun Ancient City is not as good as the Tianzun Wheel of Life and Death, a real divine weapon, not to mention it is just a phantom.
The phantom of the ancient city of life and death is crumbling, looking increasingly faint, and is about to explode due to being unable to withstand it.
"It's useless, Xiao Xuan, you are not as good as me in terms of cultivation level or divine weapon level, how can you resist?"
"Send you to death!"
Along with this, a cold and ruthless voice sounded from the Master of the Palace of Life and Death.
boom!
Tianzun's wheel of life and death is like a yin and yang sun, suddenly blasting towards the city lord of life and death.
The shadow of the ancient city of life and death only lasted for less than a moment before it exploded and turned into powder.
The avatars of the City Lord of Life and the avatars of the City Lord of Death have already risen into the sky. Together with the original body of the City Lord of Life and Death, they show a brand new Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death to resist them.
boom!
The entire land of nothingness shook violently at this moment, and billions of miles of void shattered inch by inch.
The Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death suddenly collapsed.
The clone of the Lord of Life City exploded together with the Tongtian Sacred Tree.
The clone of the Death City Lord, together with the vast world of Death Hell, turned into the billowing mist of death...
The skeletal body of the God King of the City Lord of Life and Death could no longer bear it. It was torn into pieces under the crushing power of the heavenly law of life and death, turning into bone mist and soul mist that filled the sky.
The two qi of life and death are wildly intertwined, but they can never be condensed into shape.
The three foundation-level old antiques on the side of the Temple of Life and Death looked at the mist of the God King exploding under the power of the heavenly law of life and death, with complex emotions surging in their eyes.
"Young Godson is still one step behind after all."
"The palace took the initiative to use the Tianzun Wheel of Life and Death, an attack that contains the power of the Supreme Heavenly Dao. How can the Young God Son withstand it?"
…
The supreme ancient road of the human race.
The four quasi-god-king-level ancient road protectors all looked extremely ugly.
But nothing can be done.
Lord Yanxiao's voice was gloomy: "The Lord of the City is already at a disadvantage. Now the Lord of the Palace of Life and Death has sacrificed the Heavenly Wheel of Life and Death. This blow contains the supreme power of heaven left by the Heavenly Lord of Life and Death. The Lord of the City is probably in danger."
